record.name: Pumble
record.one_liner: Pumble is a team communication and collaboration tool for messaging, video calls, and workflow automation.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free plan and generate an API key directly from the Pumble workspace addon settings.
record.api_note: The API and native MCP server cover core messaging, reactions, channels, and user management operations.

evidence.quote: Want to automate workflows, build custom messaging alerts, and connect LLMs directly to your team communication data?
This addon lets you generate an API key that allows you to send messages, reactions, and more via simple HTTP requests.
Start using Pumble for free, and upgrade when you need more features.
The Pumble API addon provides simple HTTP endpoints to handle messaging actions inside your workspace.
Pumble maintains a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) server hosted directly at pumble.com
The full list of available actions is available in the Swagger documentation.
